positions.title: Structural Engineering Intern
positions.description:
• Studied CSA S16:19 and AISC 360-16 axial, shear, bending, and bending plus axial code checks.
• Translated over 10,000 lines of code into C# to aid the migration of S-FRAME’s Steel Design Engine.
• Utilized S-STEEL to develop steel design test cases for ensuring accurate code check results.
• Created Rhino3D/Grasshopper to S-TIMBER link which sparked company interest in the parametric design market.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Visual Basic for Applications (VBA) · Visual Studio · Steel Design · Finite Element Analysis (FEA)

positions.title: SCORE Project Member
positions.description:
• Supported a student-led engineering consultancy in completing a project for a Steel Centre client.
• Developed a C# application that transfers required S-FRAME data (joint information, pass-through forces, etc.) into IDEA StatiCa for connection design.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · C# · FEM analysis · SQL

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
• Project: optimization and automation of industrial single-storey building design using parametric modelling and generative design.
• Utilized Grasshopper and Rhino3D to produce a parametric single-storey building model.
• Developed C# program that integrates S-FRAME’s structural analysis into the project workflow.
• Presented a 10-page research paper at the CSCE Conference 2021.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Computational Design · Visual Programming · Grasshopper · Parametric Design
